calculation.description: Fades the prior three-session return, with the reversal magnitude amplified when the prior completed session has unusually high volume relative to its trailing 20-session mean. Signal uses only completed bars.

validation.regime_notes: Positive results over 107 aligned 2026 date-level observations with the required minimum of 8 names, but only 9 valid names on average and approximately 15.28% overall signal coverage. Treat as selective and provisional; require broad-history revalidation before increasing weight.

provenance.lookahead_control: forward returns shifted from contemporaneous close; signal inputs shifted to completed bar
